items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: We were with Hank Biagini and we came to New York, I was only with him a couple of months.

ctx.x: Well, when did you work with him -- in whose band?
We were with Hank Biagini and we came to New York, I was only with him a couple of months.
And who was this Hank Biagmini Veogene?
